title: Improving Auto-Design of Neural PDE Solvers with a Domain-Specific Language
abstract: arXiv:2608.04384v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Neural PDE solver auto-design is fundamentally a search-space representation problem. In the space of unrestricted Python programs, valid solvers form an extremely sparse subset: most candidate programs are syntactically incorrect, semantically incompatible, or numerically unstable. Direct code generation therefore forces an LLM to spend most of its search capacity navigating implementation failures rather than reasoning about solver quality. ADSL-PDE addresses this challenge by introducing a structured search state between solver concepts and executable code. It represents the functional decisions that determine a neural PDE solver (architecture, physical constraints, objectives, sampling, and optimization) while abstracting away low-level implementation details. A deterministic compiler maps each valid search state to an executable solver. In effect, ADSL-PDE reshapes the search space: it removes large regions of invalid programs,

translated_title: 通过领域特定语言改进神经PDE求解器的自动设计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.04384v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：神经PDE求解器的自动设计从根本上是一个搜索空间表示问题。在无限制的Python程序空间中，有效的求解器构成一个极其稀疏的子集：大多数候选程序在语法上不正确、语义上不兼容或数值上不稳定。因此，直接代码生成迫使大型语言模型（LLM）将其大部分搜索能力用于处理实现失败，而非推理求解器质量。ADSL-PDE通过引入求解器概念与可执行代码之间的结构化搜索状态来解决这一挑战。它代表了决定神经PDE求解器的功能决策（架构、物理约束、目标、采样和优化），同时抽象出低层实现细节。一个确定性编译器将每个有效的搜索状态映射到可执行的求解器。实际上，ADSL-PDE重塑了搜索空间：它移除了大量无效程序区域。
tldr: ADSL-PDE通过引入结构化搜索状态和确定性编译器，重塑了神经PDE求解器的自动设计搜索空间，从而减少了无效程序，使LLM能更专注于求解器质量而非实现细节。
en_tdlr: ADSL-PDE reshapes the search space for neural PDE solver auto-design by introducing a structured search state and deterministic compiler, which eliminates invalid programs and allows LLMs to focus on solver quality rather than implementation details.
